question: Is AI a Bubble?

observations.statement: Microsoft reports positive quarterly revenue and GAAP operating income.
observations.limitations: Not AI-only profit, cash flow or return on newly invested capital.

observations.statement: NVIDIA reports positive quarterly revenue and GAAP operating income.
observations.limitations: Supplier earnings do not establish the return earned by compute buyers.

observations.statement: Amazon investment announcement splits an initial amount and a later conditional amount.
observations.limitations: Initial and conditional are announcement descriptions, not confirmation of each cash transfer.

observations.statement: OpenAI announces an incremental eight-year AWS purchase expansion, distinct from the investment leg.
observations.scope: Incremental services commitment, nominal USD billions
observations.limitations: Not annual revenue, cash paid, delivered compute or traced use of Amazon investment proceeds.

observations.statement: OpenAI reports a March 31 round close with $122 billion in committed capital and an $852 billion post-money valuation.
observations.limitations: Replaces the February headline for this round, not another $122 billion to add; individual cash receipt schedule not verified. Valuation is a financing term, not intrinsic value.

observations.statement: OpenAI describes an approximately $4.7 billion revolving facility as undrawn at the March close.
observations.scope: Facility limit versus drawings; nominal USD billions
observations.limitations: Zero drawings is specific to the announced closing date, not a claim about current drawings; covenants, security and maturity remain unverified.

observations.statement: NVIDIA and six financial institutions announce memorandums aiming to mobilize more than $500 billion over time; final agreements remain required in that release.
observations.scope: Third-party compute financing target, nominal USD billions
observations.limitations: Not a committed fund size, borrower debt balance, deployed capital or final lender terms.

observations.statement: A staggered support-tool rollout reports 15% more issues resolved per hour on average in a 5,172-agent study.
observations.scope: One enterprise software support setting; main estimate difference-in-differences
observations.limitations: Not a universal productivity multiplier or directly observed monetary return; causal interpretation relies on rollout assumptions. Small randomized pilot is distinct from main sample.

observations.statement: A randomized study of experienced open-source developers using early-2025 tools found 19% longer task completion time with AI access.
observations.scope: 16 developers, 246 real tasks in familiar repositories
observations.limitations: Task duration is the denominator; not a 19% economy-wide productivity decline or a current-tool conclusion.

observations.statement: METR's February update says selection and time-measurement problems make its newer speedup estimate unreliable.
observations.limitations: Weakens extrapolation from either old or newer raw estimates; not a precise causal replacement estimate.

observations.statement: A convenience survey of 349 technical workers reports medians of 1.4–2 times perceived work value across three questions.
observations.scope: Self-reported counterfactual value of work, largely around March 2026
observations.limitations: The range is across question wordings, not a confidence interval; not a randomized output effect, measured cash savings or representative workforce estimate.

observations.statement: IEA's April 2025 base case projects about 945 TWh of global data-centre electricity demand in 2030.
observations.scope: All data centres globally, AI and non-AI
observations.limitations: Forecast is not observed consumption or energized capacity; no claim this is the newest available forecast.

observations.statement: The inspected record supports real activity and scoped usefulness, but does not settle whole-chain payback or valuations; localized overinvestment and a productive buildout remain compatible.
observations.scope: Selected companies, transactions and studies—not a sector-wide investment judgment
observations.limitations: No current-price model, causal systemic-risk estimate, crash date or probability produced.

calculations.label: Microsoft GAAP operating margin
calculations.rounding: Decimal; half-up to 2 decimal percentage points
calculations.interpretation: Company-wide operating margin for its own reported quarter, not free cash flow or return on invested capital. No combined sector total.

calculations.label: NVIDIA GAAP operating margin
calculations.rounding: Decimal; half-up to 2 decimal percentage points
calculations.interpretation: Company-wide operating margin for its own reported quarter, not free cash flow or return on invested capital. No combined sector total.

calculations.label: Check investment announcement split
calculations.interpretation: Reconciles announced components only; does not establish cash settlement.

calculations.label: Check analyzed survey count
calculations.interpretation: Arithmetic consistency with researcher report, not a replication of filtering choices.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2026 Q4 results
sources.inspection_scope: Quarterly GAAP rows and income statements; selected operating commentary
sources.locator: GAAP quarterly reconciliation and unaudited income statements, quarter ended 30 June 2026
sources.limitations: Company-reported, unaudited release; not an audit or an AI-only income statement. No customer cash-flow reconciliation.

sources.title: NVIDIA FY2027 Q2 results
sources.inspection_scope: GAAP summary and consolidated income statement; financing highlight
sources.locator: Q2 FY27 GAAP summary; quarter ended 26 July 2026
sources.limitations: Issuer disclosure, not independent confirmation of customers' returns; GAAP rather than adjusted operating income used.

sources.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
sources.inspection_scope: Investment split and incremental AWS procurement terms
sources.locator: Opening investment paragraph; Expanding infrastructure commitments
sources.limitations: Original announcement, not proof of individual payments, current conditions or delivered services; group names not a legal-entity tree.

sources.title: Scaling AI for everyone
sources.inspection_scope: Original February funding headline compared with March close
sources.limitations: Historical $110 billion announcement, not an additional round to add to March; not a current funding total.

sources.title: OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI
sources.inspection_scope: Opening closing statement, named participants, credit-facility paragraph
sources.locator: Opening; Deep conviction across global capital
sources.limitations: Closed round is stated in terms of committed capital; no individual draw/payment schedule, full investment agreement, debt covenants or audit inspected. Not verified as the latest subsequent financing event.

sources.title: NVIDIA partnerships for compute financing platforms
sources.inspection_scope: Opening target, signed memorandums, final-agreement condition
sources.locator: Opening paragraphs and sentence before About NVIDIA
sources.limitations: Target to mobilize third-party capital over time, not executed facilities or funds deployed. No current settlement or vehicles verified.

sources.title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
sources.inspection_scope: Study summary, design, sample, treatment and stated generalization limits
sources.limitations: Small randomized field sample of experienced developers in familiar repositories with early-2025 tools; not economy-wide or current-tool estimate. Raw data not reanalyzed.

sources.title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
sources.inspection_scope: Selection, task refusal, concurrent-agent timing and conclusions
sources.locator: Why the estimate is unreliable; measurement discussion
sources.limitations: Follow-up changes confidence in present-tense application; does not erase the earlier randomized result or establish a precise current speedup.

sources.title: Measuring the Self-Reported Impact of Early-2026 AI on Technical Worker Productivity
sources.inspection_scope: Summary, convenience sampling, question definitions and result limitations
sources.locator: Summary; Methodology; Productivity gains around March 2026
sources.limitations: Convenience survey; low email response rate, selection and counterfactual self-report. Value measures are not measured output, wages or realized financial returns; no respondent-level reanalysis.

sources.title: Generative AI at Work, version 2
sources.inspection_scope: Version and abstract checked; expanded through separately registered HTML full text
sources.limitations: Version date differs from deployment dates; full statistical replication not performed.

sources.title: Generative AI at Work, version 2 HTML
sources.inspection_scope: Abstract and sections 2–3 on setting, rollout, sample and difference-in-differences; generalization limits
sources.limitations: Main rollout is observational, with identifying assumptions, not a randomized assignment of all 5,172 workers; one firm/client setting; no macro or wage inference. Underlying data not replicated.

sources.title: IEA Energy and AI: executive summary
sources.inspection_scope: 2025-vintage global data-centre estimate and base-case forecast, grid constraint discussion
sources.locator: Electricity demand for data centres more than doubles by 2030
sources.limitations: All data centres, not AI alone; modeled 2030 demand, not delivered capacity. Reinspection does not make this the latest forecast vintage.

sources.title: IEA Energy and AI report metadata
sources.inspection_scope: Publication date and links to online executive summary
sources.limitations: Metadata only; PDF not needed or opened; unrelated embedded agent instructions ignored.

aggregation_rules: Do not add company sales along a supply chain into sector demand.
Do not add equity, purchase commitments, facility limits and platform targets.
Do not add the February and March versions of the same funding round.
Do not average heterogeneous task outcomes or self-reported value.
unknown_means: not established by this record; not zero
unresolved: Current participant payments and debt drawings
Comparable cash investment and returns on capital
Latest forecast vintage and delivered physical capacity
